summary: The interpretation and both knowledge reissues were accepted, so the transfer question now rests on a receipt whose intervention is the explicit call alone. That receipt is a single run, which is precisely what the rewritten limitation admits, so this turn repeats 8570d0703c8e4132968626ba58c059c2-experiment from its retained inputs rather than opening anything new. Both cases rerun unchanged: the demoted-target case either reproduces the nil future, the six leaderless samples in roughly 475 and the maximum term climbing from two to four, or it shows the interval varies, and the voter control either installs its named member with no leaderless sample and a single term advance again or does not. Because the harness never issues the automatic transfer, either outcome keeps the attribution to the explicit request intact and lets the limitation state a range instead of one measurement, which is the last thing standing between the account and a stable statement of the election cost. The request validates against the schema and carries no other changes.
